prompt: Photograph of an architect's presentation model on a dark green self-healing cutting mat. A white model of a payment gateway: a row of five tall arched gates built from clean white foamboard and museum card with crisp knife-cut edges. Soft north-window daylight from the upper left, gentle soft shadows on the mat, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, studio product photography. The mat is plain deep green with only a very faint fine grid. No text, no numbers, no logos, no hands, no tools.
